strict_pilot_failure.verification_error: AGC cycle counter was not restored; faithful processor resume requires CDU FIFO persistence

processor_resume.source_limit: Pinned ApolloGuidance::LoadState deliberately skips CYCLECOUNTER until CDU FIFOs are saved/loaded; yaAGC stores those queues in module-static state shared by same-class AGCs

scope: Complete existing registered suite, including automated graphics/SDL; no interactive QA or full-mission acceptance

pdi: Verify PAUSED Eagle and frozen original clock, capture commander/DSKY/FDAI/X-pointers and new-lit cockpit/exterior
Use Ctrl+Right from commander for DSKY, F1 exterior/cockpit and wheel zoom; F2 instruments if useful; close overlays before flight keys
Avoid the previously timed-out F4 focus cycle during initial inspection; never send flight keys with unverified Eagle focus
If reliable key down/up is available, resume once, tap/release L for0.2-0.3seconds, pause and inspect release response; remain under10resumed simseconds. Release does not imply zero angular rate
Close normally, retain actual captures/logs/named save and verify no owned process remains; no PRO/V57 or landing checklist
liftoff_visibility: Select CBLEFT with Ctrl+Left from commander; unmodified wheel down widens vertical FOV to90degree limit, while Ctrl+wheel does nothing
Window resize improves pixel size but does not expand the vertical FOV; HE PRESS/ASC center is at99.90percent height at the90degree limit, so do not click a clipped target
If ordinary right-button drag is supported by the operator/tool, look slightly downward while paused; prior CUA interface did not expose button choice, so do not invent one

Existing NASSP normal Down-arrow free-camera control is an alternative. It runs only while simulation is running. Resume briefly, hold unmodified Down for0.25-0.5simseconds, release, F5pause; shifts camera down0.05-0.1m at1x and leaves HE PRESS/ASC center around94.70-89.51percent height at90degree FOV. Confirm actual visibility/readback; this is a source-based proposal, not live acceptance

When all three controls are visible and identified, click MasterArm ON and HE PRESS/ASC, select DSKY via commander and set EngineArm ASC; require visible readbacks. If tool cannot position camera or control stays clipped, keep manual start blocked

Only then resume, press/release ] forabout0.5seconds, observe bounded separation/climb, and pause/close within30resumed simseconds including positioning time. Key release does not mean shutting down a latched running engine
